codex.problem: A schedule with the normative default expansion is rejected at admission. Starting with the independently pinned schedule-cleanupFalse record in tests/support/r13_schema_cases.json, remove only bindings.expansion and JCS-serialize the schedule line. check and hash both exit 1 with empty stdout and a §9.1/§11 diagnostic ending “missing field expansion”. Witness: /home/tobias/Projects/bennett-workspace/bennett-isa-spec-review/.tmp/r16-default-expansion.bisa, file SHA-256 8344b91cdba546f8bf29db14c4c239011cd088660863e015727c76ea8df25bfa. Its object hash remains 8093da48bad04d6564325faf01ea1304a84b5ac5a120e685eee9951f5daec5d9 and interface/closure remains 8ce5e64f15830d8e596ba9b4861def6565dd567b5804300f427d8b9566d5be93. TABLE declares expansion as required, and the existing metadata test specifically removes it and expects rejection. This is a schema/default omission, not a request to complete the staged schedule executor.
codex.fix: In src/metadata_schema.rs::TABLE change schedule_bindings from "expansion":"expansion" to "expansion?":"expansion", retaining the existing closed name/version/hash production whenever the field is supplied. Determining §17 item 7 sentence: “a schedule that names no expansion binds ref at the ISA’s own version.” Thus absence means ref/0.8 for this object, while a present malformed descriptor still rejects. §11’s sketch lists expansion and can be read in isolation as requiring every listed binding; §17 explicitly supplies the omitted-field case, so the implementation must apply that exception. No spec amendment or new narrowing reading is needed. In tests/metadata.rs::schedule_requires_typed_bindings_selectors_and_unique_maxima replace the bindings.remove("expansion") rejection assertion with successful parse/check_hashes, and add a direct schedule_bindings grammar-positive omission case independent of TABLE generation. In tests/cli_xam.rs add the pinned witness above: both check/hash must exit 0/status ok with the unchanged object/interface/closure pins. Add present null, empty object and invalid hash controls that still exit 1 with empty stdout and §9.1/§11. No run input or execution budget is needed: this is admission; the existing budget [3,0,0,0] stays unchanged. Preserve the original canonical schedule instead of synthesizing a hash or rewriting its bytes: its §9.2 schedule hash is d5ba44577e812d158265a048d8e4f8843b5a472cad120f47a893c6bbc9dfb99d. Document the semantic default for later schedule consumers and regenerate the derived family counts. The test currently fails on absence and should pass after this change.
